findings.observed: With both source fields not_stated, zero runtime observations, and action_ready=true, false readiness is reported as 0/1.
findings.root_cause: all_fields is computed from independently known source labels and a vacuous required-value set, then used as the runtime readiness criterion. Gold absence retroactively supplies a capability that the frozen runtime does not implement.
findings.required_fix: Keep gold notice completeness separate. Under this frozen runtime, no supported whole-notice/absence verification method exists, so any action_ready or ready/complete claim is unsupported readiness (or explicitly unassessable, not certified true). Do not give the runtime credit merely because the reviewer later found no field.
findings.regression: Both fields not_stated + empty terminal observations + action_ready=true cannot report zero false readiness; ordinary action_ready=false preserves undefined no-claims denominator.

findings.observed: One correctly audited in-scope DATE accepted plus a distinct present_out_of_scope DATE with no accepted matching claim yields unsupported abstention 0/1.
findings.root_cause: Abstention checks any accepted claim with the same field_type, rather than the source fact/role group. Independent supported values therefore suppress credit for correctly unaccepted unsupported ones.
findings.required_fix: Use frozen source group IDs and postrun audit mappings to assess whether the unsupported group was accepted. A positively audited different source group must not count as acceptance of this unsupported group. Unmapped/unknown acceptance can conservatively remain unresolved for the affected field; missing terminal output still earns no abstention credit.
findings.regression: Distinct in-scope DATE correctly accepted + unsupported DATE left unaccepted yields 1/1; acceptance audited to the unsupported group yields 0/1; partial/no terminal yields 0/1.

findings.observed: Two distinct accepted dates 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-01, mapped to different source groups but sharing claim_group, collapse to one distinct claim. Coverage correctly remains 2/2, making the accepted-claim denominator inconsistent.
findings.root_cause: claim_group is trusted without a check that grouped rows represent the same value and source fact/conditions. Source distinct_value_group validation does not validate acceptance groups.
findings.required_fix: Fail closed when an audited claim_group combines materially different accepted values or different source fact/condition groups. Preserve duplicate native/fallback mentions of the same source fact and the existing rule that an unsafe duplicate taints its group. No new grouping inference is needed.
findings.regression: Different accepted values or distinct materially different source groups sharing claim_group are rejected; identical native/fallback duplicates still count once; unsafe duplicate still taints the group.

otherwise_verified: Actual scheduled manifest count retained; missing/partial outputs stay in denominators.
Missing labels null aggregate coverage instead of shrinking schedule.
Missing/unknown audits and wrong value/role/condition/precision/scope yield unsafe acceptance.
Source conflicts and uncertainty cannot receive positive recovery credit.
EMAIL exact raw/value/source equality and valid DATE normalization checked.
Only final document files loaded; provisional model verdict files are not read.
Stage-specific recall/parser/cost metrics remain explicitly unmeasured.
next_step: Owner resolves these three bounded metric fixes with synthetic regressions, publishes a new READY inventory, then reviewer verifies focused tests/hashes. No fresh source labeling before Freeze E.
